صحيح.meaning: Authentic — sound chain, reliable narrators, no defects

صحيح لذاته.meaning: Authentic in itself, meeting the full criteria independently

صحيح لغيره.meaning: Authentic due to corroborating chains, though individually weaker

حسن.meaning: Good — reliable chain, though narrators slightly less exacting than Sahih

ضعيف.meaning: Weak — fails one or more conditions of Sahih/Hasan

ضعيف جدا.meaning: Severely weak, cannot be strengthened by corroboration

موضوع.meaning: Fabricated — falsely attributed to the Prophet

منكر.meaning: Denounced — a weak narration contradicting a more reliable one

شاذ.meaning: Irregular — contradicts a narration from a more reliable source

معلول.meaning: Defective — has a subtle, hard-to-detect flaw

مضطرب.meaning: Confused — conflicting versions of equal apparent strength

منقطع.meaning: Disconnected — a missing link in the chain of narrators

مرسل.meaning: A narration where a Successor (not a Companion) reports directly from the Prophet, omitting the Companion link

معضل.meaning: Two or more consecutive narrators missing from the chain

مدرج.meaning: Interpolated — words added into the text by a narrator

مقلوب.meaning: Reversed — names or wording swapped, altering the original

متروك.meaning: Abandoned — narrated by someone considered unreliable or suspected of lying

موقوف.meaning: Stopped — attributed to a Companion, not the Prophet directly

مرفوع.meaning: Elevated — attributed directly to the Prophet

مقطوع.meaning: Cut off — attributed to a Successor (a generation after the Companions)

غريب.meaning: Unusual/rare — narrated through only one chain or by only one narrator
